status: Held, unmerged. Frozen CPU and native RSS controls failed; never resample this source/design unchanged.

source.scope: Native complete state dependency checker; production helper plus contracts and shared profiling fixture

policy.goal: Remove transient state snapshot allocation from complete retained-splice invalidation checks in Fincode rendering
policy.iteration: Check state versions in place while excluding the per-frame marker; preserve entity/global/state/deadline priority
policy.primary_cpu_gate: At least20% lower median thread CPU and elapsed; reduction must exceed both full observed lane ranges
policy.requested_memory_gate: Eliminate primary transient requested bytes/calls/peak, with zero final requested retention. No increase on any control.
policy.control_cpu_elapsed_rss_gate: All median increases must fit baseline max-minus-min. Separate census native RSS follows the same rule.
policy.measurement_scope: Complete App dependency check, with setup/recording/warmup outside measurement. Bare System timing separate from global counting census, native child RSS.
policy.fixed_overhead: No cache, App/Window fields or persistent owner change.
policy.production_relevance: Window::rebuild_reason_besides_dirty uses dependencies_changed_except for every retained splice candidate; a nonretainable descendant leaves an every-frame marker in the enclosing own dependencies.
limits: Linux native component, not whole-frame/app/GPU or shipped mimalloc percentages
policy.status: Declared before any new candidate performance samples
